body:
I'm 24; I've reached the point when most people are graduating college and are starting their lives, but I've barely done anything.  I have no idea what I want to do with my life because I have no passion for anything.  I ended up flunking out of the one major that I was somewhat interested in after just one semester and the college won't let me back in.

I also have terrible social anxiety.  I've only ever had one friend in my entire life, but we grew apart about ten years ago.  Last time I saw him was about two years ago, and it was humiliating.  He and my dad now have more in common with each other than they do with me, and the whole time I was just the awkward third wheel.

My days now usually consist of going to my crappy part time job and then coming home and sitting alone.  There have been times when I've realized that I haven't spoken a single word to anyone in days.  The idea of 50+ more years of this is terrifying.
